statement: For every excellent henselian local domain R of dimension N>=2 with residue field Fpbar, CH_1(Spec R)_Q=CH^(N-1)(Spec R minus its closed point)_Q=0; any defined ordinary B quotient therefore vanishes.
depends_on: Lipman surface resolution; Stacks normalized point blowups and SNC; KST Theorem A/(1.6); GH Theorem A with p nilpotent; vector-bundle determinant; surface normalization and Chow pushforward
notes: Includes mixed characteristic, nonnormal ambient domains and nonregular punctures; no algebraizability or resolution beyond dimension two. No integral vanishing or uniform exponent.
